description: npmdex — a better npm package search engine with rich metadata, quality scores, and fast in-memory search

userStories.title: Set up monorepo structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a well-organized monorepo so that all services share tooling, types, and configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Monorepo root with shared tsconfig base and workspace configuration (Node.js workspaces)
Workspaces for packages/index-service, packages/score-service, packages/api, packages/web, and packages/shared
Each workspace has its own package.json and tsconfig.json extending the root base
Shared ESLint and Prettier config at the root
Typecheck passes across all workspaces

userStories.title: Define shared database schema and types
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a PostgreSQL schema using Drizzle with TypeScript types so all services have a common data model.
acceptanceCriteria: packages table with fields: name (PK), description, latest_version, license, homepage_url, repository_url, keywords (array), created_at, updated_at

package_metadata table with fields: package_name (FK), weekly_downloads, github_stars, github_open_issues, last_commit_date, has_typescript_support (enum: native, definitely-typed, none), readme_length, dependency_count
package_scores table with fields: package_name (FK), overall_score (0-100), popularity_score, maintenance_score, quality_score, scored_at
Migration scripts to create the schema (e.g. using a migration library or raw SQL files)
Shared TypeScript types/interfaces for all tables defined in packages/shared
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build npm registry crawler
userStories.description: As a system, I need to crawl the npm registry so that package data is available for search.
acceptanceCriteria: index-service connects to the npm registry API and fetches package metadata
Stores name, description, latest version, license, homepage, repository URL, keywords, and weekly download counts in the packages and package_metadata tables
Supports both full sync (initial load) and incremental sync (new/updated packages since last run) using the CouchDB /_changes feed
Respects npm registry rate limits
Logs progress and errors to console
Writes results to PostgreSQL database
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build GitHub metadata enrichment
userStories.description: As a system, I need to fetch GitHub stats for packages so that search results include repository health data.
acceptanceCriteria: For packages with a GitHub repository URL, fetches: stars, open issues count, and last commit date via GitHub REST API v3
Uses GitHub personal access token from GITHUB_TOKEN env var for authentication
Handles packages without a GitHub repo gracefully (null values)
Respects GitHub API rate limits (~5000 req/hr authenticated)
Writes results to the package_metadata table
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build TypeScript support detection
userStories.description: As a system, I need to detect whether a package supports TypeScript so users can filter and evaluate packages.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects native TypeScript support (types/typings field in package.json)
Detects @types/* package availability on the npm registry
Stores result as enum: 'native', 'definitely-typed', or 'none' in has_typescript_support column
Integrated into the index-service crawl pipeline
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build the score service
userStories.description: As a system, I need to compute an overall quality score for each package so users can quickly evaluate packages.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads package data and metadata from PostgreSQL
Computes popularity sub-score from downloads and stars
Computes maintenance sub-score from last commit recency and open issues ratio
Computes quality sub-score from has_types, has_license, description length, low dependency count
Combines sub-scores into a single 0-100 overall score
Writes scores to the package_scores table with a scored_at timestamp
Only re-scores packages whose metadata updated_at is newer than scored_at
Runs as a batch job that can be triggered via CLI command
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Set up Redis with RediSearch and populate search index
userStories.description: As a system, I need the search data in an in-memory datastore so that queries are fast.
acceptanceCriteria: docker-compose.yml at repo root with Redis Stack (redis/redis-stack) container exposing RediSearch
Redis connection config reads from environment variables (REDIS_HOST, REDIS_PORT) with localhost defaults
Index service populates Redis from PostgreSQL with package data, metadata, and scores
RediSearch schema created with full-text fields for name, description, and keywords
Numeric fields indexed for downloads, stars, score for sorting
Supports incremental updates (only changed packages re-indexed)
Index build/sync time is logged
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build the search API
userStories.description: As a user, I need a search API so the frontend can query packages.
acceptanceCriteria: API service added to docker-compose.yml, connects to the Redis Stack container on the Docker network
GET /api/search?q=<query>&page=<n>&limit=<n>&sort=<field> endpoint in packages/api
Returns: package name, description, latest version, weekly downloads, GitHub stars, last commit date, TypeScript support, overall score, keywords
Queries Redis/RediSearch for search — does NOT query PostgreSQL
Results ranked by relevance (weighted combination of text match score and overall quality score) by default
Supports sort parameter with values: relevance (default), downloads, score, stars, updated
Pagination with total count in response
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build search frontend — search input and results list
userStories.description: As a user, I want a fast, clean search interface so I can find npm packages quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: React + Vite app in packages/web
Search input with debounced querying (no submit button required)
Each result card shows: package name (links to npmjs.com), description, version, weekly downloads, GitHub stars, last commit date, TypeScript support badge, overall score, keywords
Repository link opens GitHub repo (external link)
Loading spinner and empty state handled
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Build search frontend — sort, pagination, and responsive design
userStories.description: As a user, I want to sort and page through results on any device.
acceptanceCriteria: Sort dropdown with options: Relevance, Downloads, Score, Stars, Recently Updated
Results are paginated (page controls or infinite scroll)
Clean, minimal design — information-dense but not cluttered
Mobile responsive layout
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Search relevance tuning
userStories.description: As a user, I want search results that are more relevant than npmjs.com so I find the right package faster.
acceptanceCriteria: Exact name match is always the first result
Partial name matches rank higher than description-only matches
Quality score is factored into ranking (high-quality packages surface above abandoned ones with similar text matches)
Common queries like 'react', 'express', 'lodash' return expected top results
Typecheck passes
